title: Governance Delivery Metrics
description: Seller-attributed delivery metrics for a reporting period: spend, impressions, distributions, pacing, and the statement ID, digest, and sequence that bind them.

statement_id.description: Stable seller-issued identifier for this immutable delivery statement.

statement_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 JCS over {seller_reference, delivery_metrics}, excluding statement_digest itself. The authenticated submission binds the seller to this digest.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence for this governed action. A statement ID or sequence cannot be reused with different content.

issued_at.description: When the seller issued the canonical statement.

reporting_period.description: Start and end timestamps for the reporting window.

spend.description: Total spend during the reporting period.

cumulative_spend.description: Total spend since the governed action started.

currency.description: Currency of spend fields; must match the plan and planned delivery.

impressions.description: Impressions delivered during the reporting period.

cumulative_impressions.description: Total impressions since the governed action started.

geo_distribution.title: Geo Distribution
geo_distribution.description: Actual geographic distribution. Keys are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, values are percentages.

channel_distribution.title: Channel Distribution
channel_distribution.description: Actual channel distribution. Keys are channel enum values, values are percentages.

pacing.description: Whether delivery is ahead of, on track with, or behind the planned pace.

audience_distribution.description: Actual audience composition during the reporting period. Enables mid-flight drift detection when actual delivery skews from planned audience targeting.

baseline.description: Population baseline used for index calculation. 'census': national census or equivalent population data. 'platform': the seller's active user base. 'custom': a custom baseline defined by the seller (describe in baseline_description).

baseline_description.description: Description of the baseline when baseline is 'custom' (e.g., 'US adults 18+ with broadband access').

indices.description: Audience index values for the current reporting period. Keys are seller-defined dimension:value strings (e.g., 'age:25-34', 'gender:female', 'income:high'). The protocol does not mandate a taxonomy — dimensions and value labels vary by seller. Values are index relative to the declared baseline (1.0 = at parity, >1.0 = over-indexed, <1.0 = under-indexed).

cumulative_indices.description: Cumulative audience index values since the governed action started. Same key format as indices (dimension:value). Use for detecting sustained bias drift that may not appear in a single reporting period.
